name: What should you ask an ADU contractor before building the kitchen?

mainEntity.name: Which kitchen-specific questions help you compare ADU contractors before signing a contract?
mainEntity.text: Which kitchen-specific questions help you compare ADU contractors before signing a contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring an ADU contractor, the kitchen questions often reveal the quality of the whole project. Ask who is responsible for kitchen design, whether appliance sizes are locked before permitting, and how the contractor handles plumbing, electrical, and ventilation coordination. It is also smart to ask about cabinet lead times, countertop templating, and how changes are billed if the homeowner chooses different finishes later. A contractor who understands ADUs should be able to explain how the kitchen fits the unit type, the available utility capacity, and the overall layout. If the answers are vague, the project may be at risk of delays or expensive redesigns. Homeowners should also ask to see examples of similar small kitchens, not just large custom homes, because compact space planning is a separate skill. In Los Angeles and nearby cities, the best contractor is usually the one who can show a clear process for getting the kitchen from concept to final inspection without surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how they handle appliance selection, utility coordination, permit revisions, cabinet lead times, ventilation, and panel capacity. Also ask who designs the kitchen, who measures for counters, and how change orders are handled. Clear answers usually show whether the contractor understands small-space ADU construction.
